interface.shortDescription: Preview your web app on phone
interface.longDescription:
Create and list phone previews of a web app you have already published, and get clear steps to open each preview in the BDK Preview app on your own phone. BDK Native turns live web apps into iOS and Android apps.

Give ChatGPT the published address of your web app, not an editor or builder share link. BDK checks the link and creates a preview in your account. If a preview for that address already exists, it is reused. An account can hold up to 20 previews.

To open a preview, install BDK Preview and sign in with the same BDK account. On iPhone, BDK Preview opens only your own previews. Sign-in codes are never shown in chat.

This plugin only reads and creates previews in the BDK account you connect. It does not change installed apps, app settings, builds or store listings; those stay in your BDK account at thebdk.com.
capabilities: Create phone previews of a published web app
List the previews in your BDK account
Explain how to open a preview on your own phone
defaultPrompt: Make a phone preview of my web app.
How do I open my newest preview on my iPhone?
